info.title: Quantum Inventions TrackSynq Utilities API
info.description: APIs to manage the TrackSynq resources

parameters.name: data-access-token
parameters.description: Data Access Token provided by API admin

parameters.name: serverHost
parameters.description: URL of the server where the Device/Vehicle is added, e.g dev.tracksynq.com

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: Id of the application/client to access data

parameters.name: events
parameters.description: Event names as comma separated (Default: IDILING,IGNITION_ONOFF,SPEEDING,SPEEDING) can use /events/eventrules API to get the available events for the application or check with developer for any additional events

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: From date, in Vehicle Tracker application local time, that you want to get the events for. (for example 01-08-2020T00:00:00 or 01-08-2020)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: To date, in Vehicle Tracker application local time, that you want to get the event for. (for example 01-08-2020T23:59:59 or 01-08-2020) If time is not provided default 23:59:59 is added to end date

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: User Id, by default it is 0. If Device IMEI is provided then this param is ignored

parameters.name: vehiclePlateNumber
parameters.description: Vehicle unique plate number e.g SMY8829

parameters.name: deviceImei
parameters.description: Device IMEI/Unique Id, should be minimum 6 and maximum 20 characters and can be alpha numeric

parameters.name: openEvents
parameters.description: Send it as true to get open events, false to get closed events, empty will return all events

400.description: Indicates the request could not be understood by the server. Some of the required parameters are missing. Check the message for missing information details

403.description: The server understood the request, but is refusing to fulfill it. Authentication key might be in valid and the request SHOULD NOT be repeated

424.description: The server understood the request, but the dependency service failed to respond. Please try again

500.description: Indicates that a generic error has occurred on the server

501.description: Indicates the API does not exist/not implemented

502.description: The server received invalid response from the intermediate server

503.description: The server is currently unable to handle the request due to maintenance of the server or because the service is not running

Value.description: Argument value, arguments from events. It can by any reference/value type

StatusTime.description: Status time in UTC and in ISO-8601 format.

DeviceVariables.description: List of the device variable data.

BillingApplicationDetailDto.description: Detail view of a single application, enriched with latest snapshot summary.

BillingApplicationDto.description: Lightweight projection of `TrackSynqApplication` for list views.

BillingSnapshotsEnabled.description: The `billing_snapshots_enabled` flag. null/true = billing-enabled; false = excluded from sync + billing.

CountryCode.description: Operator-assigned country for this server (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 + name). Applied to the server's applications.

IsBillable.description: Computed: true when the server participates in billing (flag is not explicitly false).

ApplicationCount.description: Total applications synced under this server.

BillableApplicationCount.description: Applications under this server that would actually be invoiced (Xero contact set AND active).

Countries.description: Distinct ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes across this server's applications (for grouping/filtering). Usually one.

BillingServerDto.description:
Server-level projection for the dashboard's top-level navigation (servers → applications →
vehicles / snapshots). Only safe metadata is exposed — connection strings / API credentials
from the servers table are deliberately omitted.

VehicleOtherApplications.description:
Parallel to VehicleIds - for the vehicle at the same index, the other billable
application ids on this server that also billed it this month (GpsGate reseller/dealer
hierarchies can expose the same vehicle through more than one application; each is
billed independently, this is for audit/reconciliation visibility). Empty = no overlap.

BillingSnapshotDetailDto.description: Detail view of a snapshot — adds the vehicle id/plate lists + pricing snapshot.

DeviceType.description: Device type e.g Android, QI Generic. Check with API provider for this info.

DriverIdentifier.description: Driver identifier, e.g DriverID tag, RFID etc.

PhoneNumber.description: Phone number including the country code, eg. 658647894.

LastUpdated.description: Last updated status time in UTC and ISO-8601 format.

DriverId.description: Driver identifier, e.g DriverID tag, RFID etc.

PhoneNumber.description: Phone number including the country code, eg. 658647894.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

Message.description: A human-readable explanation for the API error

ErrorResponse.description: Custom application wise API error response.

UserId.description: Event generated by asset user identifier.

Name.description: Event name, e.g OVER_SPEEDING, IDLING etc.

StartTime.description: Event start time in UTC and ISO-8601 format.

EndTime.description: Event end time in UTC and ISO-8601 format.

Name.description: Rule name, e.g OVER_SPEEDING, IDLING etc.
Device variable name e.g Speed, FuelPercentage, HDOP, Mileage.

MappedVariableName.description: Device variable mapped names e.g Mileage is mapped to _Odometer, Mileage.

Name.description: Variable name, e.g Speed, FuelLevel etc.

Value.description: Variable value respresented as string, refer to Type property to convert the value.

ReceivedOn.description: Variable data last received at server in UTC and in ISO-8601 format.

StartDateTime.description: Track start date & time in UTC and ISO-8601 format.

EndDateTime.description: Track end date & time in UTC and ISO-8601 format.

TrackUpdatedOn.description: Track last updated date & time in UTC and ISO-8601 format.

UtcTime.description: Track point date & time in UTC and ISO-8601 format.

ApplicationId.description: Optional — scope the run to one application. Must be supplied together with QI.TrackSynq.API.Controllers.v4.TriggerBillingRunRequest.ServerHost.

ServerHost.description: Optional — scope the run to one application. Must be supplied together with QI.TrackSynq.API.Controllers.v4.TriggerBillingRunRequest.ApplicationId.

StartDateTime.description: Trip start date & time in UTC and ISO-8601 format.

EndDateTime.description: Trip end date & time in UTC and ISO-8601 format.

CountryCode.description:
Manual country override. Setting QI.TrackSynq.API.Models.Dtos.Billing.UpdateBillingApplicationRequest.CountryCode (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) marks the
application's country as manually maintained — the sync stops re-deriving it from the
timezone. QI.TrackSynq.API.Models.Dtos.Billing.UpdateBillingApplicationRequest.CountryName is optional; if omitted it's derived from the code.

BillingCustomerName.description: Billing-specific customer details (independent of the Xero mapping). Null fields are left unchanged.

UpdateBillingApplicationRequest.description:
PUT body for `/admin/v4/billing/applications/{serverHost}/{applicationId}`. Every
property is nullable — null fields don't overwrite the existing value on the row. Allows
the portal to send sparse partial updates (e.g. "just the unit amount").

Events.description: User events, in key/pair format where in key is the event name and pair is the events info.

PhoneNumber.description: User phonenumber including country code e.g 6584698226 .

UserType.description: User type e.g Supervisor, Area Manager etc.

VehicleCountByApplicationDto.description:
Billable vehicle count for one application for a given month. Duplication across
applications is intentional here (a vehicle visible through more than one application on a
server bills independently under each) - see QI.TrackSynq.API.Models.Dtos.Billing.VehicleCountByServerDto and
QI.TrackSynq.API.Models.Dtos.Billing.VehicleCountByCountryDto for the deduplicated rollups.

VehicleCountByCountryDto.description:
Distinct billable vehicle count for one country for a given month, summed across every
server/application in that country. Deduplicated the same way as
QI.TrackSynq.API.Models.Dtos.Billing.VehicleCountByServerDto - never double-counts a vehicle visible through more
than one application. CountryCode is null for applications with no resolved country.

VehicleCountByServerDto.description:
Distinct billable vehicle count for one server for a given month. Deduplicated by vehicle id
across every application on that server - a vehicle counted under two applications on the
same server (GpsGate reseller/dealer hierarchies can expose it through more than one) counts
once here, unlike QI.TrackSynq.API.Models.Dtos.Billing.VehicleCountByApplicationDto.

DriverIdentifier.description: Paired driver id, it will the Driver ID tag/RFID.

DeviceActivity.description: Vehicle device last activity date & time in UTC and ISO-8601 format.

DeviceVariables.description: List of the device variable data.
